SELECT CAST( COALESCE(upcoming.upcoming_score, 0) * 1 + COALESCE(on_sale.on_sale_score, 0) * 2 + COALESCE(follow_week.week_follow_count, 0) * 10 AS SIGNED) AS heat_value FROM (SELECT 1) base
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT SUM( COALESCE(e.want_count, 0) * 3 + COALESCE(e.page_views, 0) * 0.5 ) AS upcoming_score FROM tb_event e INNER JOIN tb_event_artist ea ON ea.event_id = e.id WHERE ea.artist_id = #{artistId} AND e.status <> 4 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tb_event_session s WHERE s.event_id = e.id AND s.status <> 4 AND s.show_time >= NOW() ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tb_event_session s2 WHERE s2.event_id = e.id AND s2.status <> 4 AND s2.sale_time IS NOT NULL AND s2.sale_time <= NOW() AND s2.show_time >= NOW() ) ) upcoming ON 1 = 1
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT SUM( COALESCE(e.want_count, 0) * 3 + COALESCE(e.page_views, 0) * 0.5 + COALESCE(sold.sold_count, 0) * 10 ) AS on_sale_score FROM tb_event e INNER JOIN tb_event_artist ea ON ea.event_id = e.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT event_id, SUM(quantity) AS sold_count FROM tb_order WHERE status IN (3, 4, 6) GROUP BY event_id ) sold ON sold.event_id = e.id WHERE ea.artist_id = #{artistId} AND e.status = 1 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tb_event_session s WHERE s.event_id = e.id AND s.status <> 4 AND s.sale_time IS NOT NULL AND s.sale_time <= NOW() AND s.show_time >= NOW() ) ) on_sale ON 1 = 1
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT COUNT(1) AS week_follow_count FROM tb_user_favorite f WHERE f.type = 2 AND f.target_id = #{artistId} AND f.create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) ) follow_week ON 1 = 1
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM tb_user_favorite f WHERE f.type = 2 AND f.target_id = #{artistId} AND f.create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)
